correctness.rationale: For even n>=2, eta>0 the proper energy E=v²/2+x^(2n+2)/(2n+2) has E_dot=-eta*x^n*v²<=0, excluding finite positive-time blow-up and forcing convergence to the origin. Projective z=v/x^(n+1) obeys z_dot=-x^n[(n+1)z²+eta*z+1]; its quadratic has no real root precisely 0<eta<2sqrt(n+1), giving no fixed angular direction, while real invariant rays stop infinite full rotations above threshold. On the oscillatory side, d log |x|/dz=-z/P(z) yields the exact contraction of crossing speeds q=exp(-pi*eta/sqrt(4(n+1)-eta²)). Physical time dt/dtheta is a positive integrable (cos theta)^(-n/(n+1)) quadrature and gives C_{n,eta} V^-alpha. Geometric backward flight durations sum to C V^-alpha q^alpha/(1-q^alpha); quasi-homogeneous flow self-similarity forces exact logarithmic antiperiodicity and minimal period 2pi*n*eta/[(n+1)*sqrt(4(n+1)-eta²)]. Independently integrated full ODE via high-accuracy adaptive solver for (n,eta)=(2,1),(4,0.8): crossing-speed errors <4e-12 against predicted q. Numerical runs cannot establish global all-n winding/boundary claims, which follow from the projective monotonicity and energy/global time argument.
